== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Enforce refers to a category of techniques used by [[sacred artists]] to manipulate [[madra]] for various physical and combat applications. While basic enforcement involves the inefficient process of pouring [[madra]] into the body to provide strength or support heavy lifting, specialized [[Enforcer techniques]] offer much higher efficiency and power. These techniques vary significantly depending on the user's specific [[Path]]; some focus on full-body reinforcement to protect and empower the user, while others are concentrated into single strikes, such as a [[sword]] slash or a palm-strike. [[Enforcer techniques]] can be applied to the body, weapons, or even spirits. For example, some users use them to increase speed, enhance physical durability, or reinforce a weapon's edge. Certain advanced techniques can even manifest as visible forms, such as translucent armor or a blue nimbus. However, these abilities often come with significant physical costs, such as straining joints, burning muscles, or exhausting [[madra]] reserves rapidly. In some instances, specialized training is required to move beyond basic reinforcement to unlock a [[technique]]'s true potential.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Enforce is a [[technique]] that allows a practitioner to reinforce their body using [[madra]]. During an instance where servants shouted, the [[technique]] was used to Enforce their cries, which caused the surrounding sand to shake. [[Lindon]] utilized this method to Enforce his own body and later applied the [[Enforcer technique]] specifically to his arms. Additionally, the [[technique]] can be employed to assist with breathing.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Enforce]] is a [[technique]] used to reinforce the body with [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The servants' shouts were [[Enforced]], causing the nearby sand to shake.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Lindon]] used his [[madra]] to [[Enforce]] his body.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8" />}}</li>
